items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: So, you know for years Loreal and Clairol were good friends of mine.

ctx.x: Well it does have its highs and lows.

It’s just like life. But you really have to I think if you want it bad enough, you’ve got to stick with it very very deeply. I stuck with it long enough. See I didn’t join the Basie band until I was 30. And I’m 50 now and it was incredible. Everybody says, “wow you were a young kid when you were with Basie.” I say, “No, I wasn’t a young kid, I just, I had a young face, and I weight about ten pounds less than I do now and I dyed my hair.” Because we had one of those things, my hair bleached out about the second or…
